run_llama_finetune: run the llama fine-tuning script with --run-name and --data-path arguments to train on CIF crystal data
get_crystal_string: convert a CIF string to a formatted crystal structure string with lattice parameters and atomic coordinates
create_cif_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset from CSV files containing CIF crystal structures for generation and infill tasks
setup_trainer: set up a HuggingFace Trainer with a LoRA-finetuned Llama model, datasets, and data collator for crystal structure training
setup_model: load a Llama model with LoRA configuration and resize tokenizer embeddings for special tokens
